artifact: Galmaemiman UI v3 developer screen and state bindings
scope: 36 screen/modal IDs; 50 rendered review states; 95 effective workbook routes. UI adapter names below are semantic requirements, not existing API names.
source_precedence: Latest user decisions and package reference/page-manifest.json
Package qa/flow-validation.json effective_routes with explicit overrides here
Listed renderer source for each ID
review-decisions.json history (S05 pending/PDF hold fields superseded by completed final v3 artifacts)

review_decisions.note: Past S05 pending/PDF hold is superseded; do not use as final delivery status.

references.source_workbook_location: external original workbook, not bundled here

coordinates.coordinate_meaning: Canvas reference pixels only. Do not equate px to Android dp. Native safe-area, font scale, touch targets and accessibility require device testing.
coordinates.deep_content: Local pagination, horizontal swipe, tabs or contextual modal; not full-screen vertical scrolling.

theme.button_policy: Existing navy/cream textured nine-slice frames, native labels; restrained gold for key action/selection only. Separate tabs, status and actionable buttons.
theme.image_policy: Original art intact. Small slots use face/character sourceRect; full registration card for details/recruit results/craft browser. Never ship full mockup PNG as interactive screen.
theme.species_note: 태초 is a current species label and is retained. Only old D1/태초갈매미맨 legacy artwork or old extra reward is forbidden; do not globally delete species text.

recruit.reroll: per-card, once, same-grade, half category unit cost

craft_growth.actual_recipes_and_curves: not verified/connected; disable confirmation on unvalidated inputs; do not invent preview number

battle_exit.adventure_success: end current battle, preserve run bank, resume S19
battle_exit.return: outside combat only, settle then home
battle_exit.wipe: lose unbanked run rewards, settle then home

menu_locks.representative_level: max CURRENT level among owned new-roster units

interaction_contracts.mutation: Disable repeated submit while pending; validate on authoritative side; display actual receipt; safe retry by operation identity. This is required behavior, not proof a server API exists.

hold.onHold: Show description only, positioned above the battlefield and left of the pressed command.
hold.onPointerCancel: Hide description; do not cast, spend MP, or commit a turn.
hold.shortTap: Select a skill only; target/confirm before committing.

item.cancel: No use, quantity loss, or turn commit.
item.eligibility: Runtime item data must decide legal targets; mockup does not establish revive/full-HP policy.

switch.after: Former active moves to reserves; total remains 1 + 5.

interaction_contracts.settlement: Battle/result authoritative state must be resolved before origin/home navigation; disconnect/back/restart cannot bypass it.
interaction_contracts.sample_data: Every displayed balance/stat/time/rank/name/count is a review fixture unless explicitly listed under confirmed_rules. Never copy these numeric fixtures into production defaults.

route_endpoint_semantics.CALLER: Recorded origin screen + mode + selection + pending operation; restore context, never implicit home
route_endpoint_semantics.EXIT: Platform back/exit only when safe and explicitly permitted; not a bypass from battle or settlement
route_endpoint_semantics.TBD: Unresolved policy endpoint, no invented destination

R032.reason: S10 detail is in same-screen tabs; duplicate separate-detail CTA removed. Graph retained as historical/proposed edge.

R046.reason: Latest UI vocabulary; server credits is 지원서, one currency.

R066.note: 카카오 로그아웃 후 로그인으로 복귀. 로그인 문제는 재시도 안내만; 별도 계정 복구 기능 미확정.

R073.reason: Management CTA saves formation. Automatic transition to S28 after save is only an old proposal, not approved latest behavior.

R042.guard: same-grade, this card reroll unused, balance >= half category unit cost (1/3/5), transaction unclaimed; one reroll per card; no pity

R056.reason: Reward delivery destination immediate vs mail remains TBD.

asset_reference_root: Original workspace outputs/ui-mockups-20261025; source_path is provenance/hydration reference, not a claim that all images are embedded in this ZIP. Use assets/asset-references.json SHA inventory and separate original asset pack.
asset_alias_note: Logical stable handoff keys only; actual resource IDs/hashes belong to developer asset manifest. Wildcards card.* / art.front.* / art.rear.* select runtime unit ID. Missing approved art must be reported, never substituted with legacy D1.
